iron_belt_wood_sem.title: Foreign objects on an iron ore conveyor
iron_belt_wood_sem.caption: Iron ore rushes past on a conveyor belt; the model marks the ore, oversized rocks and foreign objects like wood that must be removed before they jam the crusher.
iron_belt_wood_sem.dataset: In-lab Image Dataset of Foreign Objects and Anomalies in Iron Ore Conveyor Belts (Sousa, de Oliveira, Coelho, Delabrida Silva; UFOP / Instituto Tecnologico Vale / Lakehead University), Mendeley Data V1, 2025, doi:10.17632/s25x2bnshz.1
iron_belt_wood_sem.model: D-FINE-seg-L sem_seg, 640x640 input, fine-tuned from the Cityscapes L weights on SAM/Gemini-assisted pixel labels made from this dataset's frames
iron_belt_wood_sem.split: val (video boardcamera_iron_ore_7_wood_3.mp4 is held out from training)
iron_belt_wood_sem.notes: val mIoU 0.831, pixel acc 0.982 (4 classes: background, iron, big_rock, trash). Lab-scale conveyor rig recorded at ~119 fps; shown at real-time speed (every 4th frame). Clip: boardcamera_iron_ore_7_wood_3.mp4 from 15.3s, 11.6s.

coral_reef_garden_sem.title: Reef survey transect
coral_reef_garden_sem.caption: A reef survey frame labelled pixel by pixel into 39 classes: living, bleached and dead corals by type, sand, rubble, fish and the survey tape.
coral_reef_garden_sem.dataset: Coralscapes (EPFL-ECEO), first general-purpose dense semantic segmentation dataset for coral reefs; 39 classes
coral_reef_garden_sem.model: D-FINE-seg-X sem_seg, native 1024x2048 input, trained on the Coralscapes train split only (exp x_bs2_mos08_rcs)
coral_reef_garden_sem.notes: Coralscapes test 58.38 mIoU / 82.50 pixel acc at 15 ms end-to-end (TensorRT fp16, RTX 5070 Ti) vs SegFormer-B5 58.21 / 83.02 at 39 ms.
